cases.text: My lower back has been hurting for two weeks.
Abeg my waist dey pain me well well.
Wetin dey pain me for my neck, I no fit sleep.
How you dey? Body just dey weak.
Pele, ara mi n dun ni ẹhin.
Bawo ni, mo dupe, ehin mi n dun.
Ndewo, kedu ihe mere? Ahu m na-afụ ụfụ.
Biko ndewo, nwanne m, m na-enwe nsogbu.
Na gode, yaya kake? Kirji yana ciwo.
